method: The root model visually inspected native generated sheets during corrections, all four 81-frame whole-character contact sheets, and five actual Chromium scene captures at DPR1/2. Previously inspected Ace, Sabo and Law scratch contact bytes were compared by SHA with the final export; the final Hancock contact was inspected directly after its opposite-foot correction. Final image hashes are captured here before release freeze.
limitations: Model visual review and automated browser tests are not human gameplay or physical-device acceptance.
Five rendered scene captures were visually sampled; the complete 184-capture set is bound by the separate actual browser QA, not represented as 184 manual inspections.
Official character text informed fixed costumes and relationships; no claim of pixel-for-pixel official illustration comparison or official endorsement.
Tiny hand lettering and pattern details are simplified at room scale; complete figures are uniformly scaled, never anatomically assembled.
All four production release flags stay false. These fixture images do not show publicly available characters.
